title: New Kerberos Abuse Path Discovery - Constrained Delegation without Protocol Transition against SPN-less accounts
description: A new Kerberos abuse technique has been discovered that allows constrained delegation without protocol transition to be exploited against SPN-less accounts. This method combines previous research techniques to expand the attack surface of Kerberos delegation abuse. The researcher updated Impacket to support this new abuse path, facilitating practical exploitation. No specific affected software versions or patches are identified. The threat is considered medium severity based on the described impact.
